The waffle method1 was used for grid preparation. Spore concentrations frozen per grid were as follows: 5.7 x 107 spores/µL for dataset 1; 8 x 105 spores/µL for dataset 2; 1.3 x 108 spores/µL for dataset 3. 5 µL of sample was applied to each waffle grid assembly, and the sample was frozen using Wholwend Compact 01 high pressure freezer, with a pressure of 2,100 bar.
